quest.title: Everlasting as the Moon
quest.description: Spend some time with Columbina in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I'm in!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Once the game is over, the kuuhenki rush toward you. They appear to be extremely happy.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Thank you for taking the time to play with the kuuhenki.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I hope we can have just as much fun playing together next time.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Perhaps... Like this?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Moons... Moons...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: How about here?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Looks like I won this round.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: My three moons are connected.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm, this should win it.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm... The moons wax and wane in an endless cycle...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: It seems both sets of moons refuse to be eclipsed.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Are we... heading for a tie?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, you weigh your decisions carefully before making them, I see. Take your time — we have plenty of that, after all.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Did you forget how to place your moons in the night sky? Shall I help you?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You don't like this game? Hm... I find it quite amusing myself.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm? Are you staring at me? Your gaze is not subtle.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You're staring... Is the truth of the moons written on my face?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The board's over there, by the way...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hm, your moons are aligned.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The night sky is yours.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah... I must have... slipped up somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You have a wonderful time playing the game with Columbina...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Thank you, I enjoyed that a lot.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: If you'd like... feel free to come keep me company again, sometime.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Here, take this as a token of our promise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's play Kuuhenki Hat-N-Seek.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try something from another nation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try something from another nation...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: How curious... I have heard melodies like this before, but your playing lends a whole new dimension...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ah, maybe because {NICKNAME} was channeling {M#his}{F#her} emotional connection to that place...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: What's curious is that... I feel as if I can picture the landscape just by listening to the melody. I wonder how the real thing compares to my imagination...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You should just go see it someday! We can be your tour guides!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm... Perhaps. If that day ever comes.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: We have pierced through cloud and fog, and together, witnessed the answer on the moon... Its beauty is like the music your strings now sing.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Go on now, little ones.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: See if you can guess what this picture is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, that was way too obvious!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: I'm afraid this riddle was a little too simple for us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what's wrong with this eel's waist?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: You two possess an impressive wealth of knowledge...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The correct answer is "the moon."

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Come back now. You did a wonderful job.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyone with eyes can see it's an arc! How could the answer be something so simple!?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: While you aren't technically wrong, I'm afraid that's not exactly what the kuuhenki were going for.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The correct answer is "the moon."

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Come back now. You did a wonderful job.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Go on now, friends.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: All you need to do is guess what the picture is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How did you manage to guess that!?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: So that's what it's called. Does it pick its creator up and carry her around in its hand?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks you might be confusing Aino with a former colleague of yours...

choices.text: A Weasel Thief who's eaten too much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could a Weasel Thief this stuffed still steal stuff?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Or perhaps it no longer needs to steal?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The correct answer is "the big mechanical duck next to Aino's workshop."

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Come back now. Thank you, I know that wasn't easy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, the kuuhenki learned what specialized lab equipment looks like just for this game? They're really going all out!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: That's... very close.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The correct answer is "the big mechanical duck next to Aino's workshop."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How is that close!?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Come back now. Thank you, I know that wasn't easy.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Go on now, friends.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: All you need to do is guess what the picture is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you play this with the kuuhenki before and forget to tell us?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... The body's got some resemblance, but is their cap really that round?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: You got the "floating" part right, at least...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The correct answer is the "Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau."

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Come back now. You really outdid yourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The handle seems a little short for an umbrella. How's anyone supposed to hold it?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: An umbrella... isn't something I often use. Why not just make a kuuvahki shield when it rains?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a sec! We can use that to keep the rain off, too!?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The correct answer is the "Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau."

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Come back now. You really outdid yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here? The kuuhenki are playing the lyre again. Could you play a song for them like last time?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: And I happen to be in the mood to hear something different myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm, what should I play...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try the one Columbina always sings...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try the one Columbina always sings...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But what tone should I go for...)

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: That was lovely. So you really did memorize my tune.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, only 'cause you're such a great singer! Whenever we hear your voice, sometimes we stop for a bit just to listen...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Hm, the kuuhenki seemed quite enraptured with your performance as well. Perhaps they picked up a few things...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: I might require your educational assistance again in the future.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Come, give me your hand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? No, no, this was a free performance. No tuition fee required!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Hmm? Tuition fee?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: I only thought... the gentle glow of moonlight would make a fitting accompaniment for such a beautiful melody.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Oh, it's over already? I could listen to that forever...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: As I once told you, this is the only lullaby I can remember.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Although I have yet to discern the meaning behind it, after hearing you play, I feel like whatever answer is waiting for me, up there on the moon... at the very least, it must be a beautiful one.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Here, give me your hand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's okay. Seriously, you don't need to give us anything in return.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Ah, that wasn't my intention... I only wished to adorn your melody with a ray of gentle moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: In the future... I'll be sure to let you know.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: What shall we play today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some music would be nice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's play a picture-guessing game.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's mix some drinks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's play Moon Chess.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Thank you. I enjoyed our time together.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Wherever you go, may this ray of moonlight linger upon you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm, what should I play...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, even Paimon wants to try a glass of that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I seem to have made a mistake somewhere... Let me try again.
